identityMeaning: Five APC project/review numbers are native to this DOE/APC source context; no global engineering identifier equivalence is claimed. Lock 5 uses a stable named-review locator; no edition in identity.
ownershipMeaning: No retained review expressly assigns equipment ownership. Applicant, proponent and borrower status are not ownership; all retained owners remain null. Plant Barry land ownership concerns an excluded generation project and cannot be propagated.
dateMeaning: Index dates differ from four letter dates, including excluded Roanoke. Per-record proposed lifecycleAsOf uses its letter date with source-edition meaning, not September snapshot retrieval. Reviews do not establish actual start, service or financing close.
